g.title: HR_INDIVIDUALACTION
g.text: Individual Action - Individual action with a type, a completion percentage and optionally a linked Entity that can be a workflow task of a course session enrolment.
This field identify the Appraisal section.
The action description as it will be shown when the action is created.
Refers an action type code in catalogue.
Identifier of the entity record which is linked to the action. It can be Learner record Id or a Process Instance Id.
The person who the activity is assigned to.
The relative sort order of the activity when compared to the other activities in the same plan.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
The Responsible of the Individual Action

g.title: HR_APPRAISALSECTION
g.text: Appraisal Review Section - This entity represents a section of an individual appraisal review, where the section scores are recorded.
Indicates the weighting as a percentage
The Identifier of the Job record.
description of field objective plan for entity appraisal section
This is the numeric score that comes from a manual adjustment. By default, it is equal to the calculated score and can be changed by authorised users.
This is the score expressed as a percentage.
This is the percentage score that comes from a manual adjustment. By default, it is equal to the calculated percentage score and can be changed by authorised users.
The opportunity associated to a specific section.
The section bonus opportunity converted to System Currency.
Opportunity adjusted field description of appraisal review section.
The section Opportunity Adjusted converted to System Currency.
Payout percentage field description of appraisal review section.
Payout percentage adjusted field description of appraisal review section.
Payout field description of appraisal review section.
The section Payout converted to System Currency.
Payout adjusted field description of appraisal review section.
The section Adjusted Payout converted to System Currency.
This field contains the weight of this section result when calculating the bonus for the objective to which it belongs.
The Identifier of the Currency record.
